name: Tabby
description: Self-hosted AI coding assistant server offering code completion, chat and a codebase answer engine on your own hardware.
whatItDoes: Tabby gives teams an on-premises alternative to hosted coding assistants. It serves completions and chat to editor plugins and can answer questions grounded in connected repositories. Everything outside the enterprise directory is Apache-2.0.
howItWorks: A single Rust server loads a completion model and a chat model and exposes them over an OpenAPI interface. Editor extensions call that server, and it can run on consumer-grade GPUs. No external database or cloud service is required.

requirements.name: Docker
requirements.description: The documented quick start runs the server as a container

requirements.name: GPU
requirements.description: The example command uses CUDA for model inference

run: docker run -it --gpus all -p 8080:8080 -v $HOME/.tabby:/data tabbyml/tabby serve --model StarCoder-1B --device cuda --chat-model Qwen2-1.5B-Instruct
models: Self-hosted open models such as StarCoder and Qwen
